items.title: Regularity of a Noetherian local ring is unchanged by completion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a Noetherian local ring is regular exactly when its completion is. One direction is quoted from the result that regularity descends along the flat completion map. For the other, the author uses that the dimension of the ring equals that of its completion, so the minimal number of generators of the maximal ideal of the ring equals the dimension of the completion, while the maximal ideal of the completion is generated by the extended maximal ideal and hence by at most that many elements; regularity of the completion follows. An alternative reference is also recorded.
